_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which companies get found, which person at each company gets the connection request, and what the note says. This is the SHIPPED DEFAULT. The live, user-edited copy is outreach_config.json (gitignored). Both skills load the live config at the START of every run - scheduled or on-demand - and use ONLY these values. To retarget, follow RETARGETING.md, which edits the live outreach_config.json. Never edit knob values inline in the skills; edit them here.
campaign_label: Data teams at companies hiring analysts

finder.search_mode_label: companies currently hiring for the keyword

persona_tiers.who: Head of Data, Head of Analytics, Director of Data, VP Data
Data/Analytics Manager or Senior Manager who owns the analyst team
CTO, Chief Data Officer, VP Engineering at smaller companies
Founder, Co-founder or CEO - use at companies under 50 people

outreach.note_tone: Warm, direct, peer-to-peer. Sounds like a real person, not a pitch. No flattery, no buzzwords, no exclamation marks.
note_must_include: one concrete detail about their company or team
note_must_avoid: I hope this finds you well
outreach.note_ask: Simple connect ask. No meeting request, no link, no attachment in the first note.
outreach.followup_tone: Short, useful, one clear ask. Reference the note they accepted.
